# Aurum Art

> Aurum Art is a creative supplies retailer offering curated art kits and designer stationery boxes for artists of all skill levels.

Aurum Art specializes in Artful Art School in a Box kits and Papergang designer stationery collections, featuring mixed media, calligraphy, colored pencils, and paint markers. The company partners with charitable organizations like Tree Aid and Kidscape, embedding social impact into their product offerings.

## Artful Art School Kits

- [Calligraphy Art Kit](https://aurum.art/artful-art-school-in-a-box-calligraphy-kit): Calligraphy kit featuring Tombow ABT and Twin Tone markers
- [Colouring Pencil Kit](https://aurum.art/artful-art-school-in-a-box-colouring-pencil-kit): Premium colored pencil kit for beginner artists
- [Mixed Media Art Kit](https://aurum.art/artful-art-school-in-a-box-mixed-media-art-kit): Mixed media art kit with diverse materials and techniques
- [Paint Markers Art Kit](https://aurum.art/artful-art-school-in-a-box-paint-markers-art-kit): Acrylic paint markers kit for bold, colorful artwork

## Papergang Stationery Collections

- [Bright Ideas Stationery Box](https://aurum.art/papergang-bright-ideas-stationery-box): Designer stationery box by Jessica Forgie supporting Kidscape
- [Nature's Neutrals Stationery Box](https://aurum.art/papergang-natures-neutrals-stationery-box): Nature-inspired stationery by Maus Haus with Tree Aid partnership
- [Rise Above It Stationery Box](https://aurum.art/papergang-rise-above-it-stationery-box): Calligraphy-inspired stationery by Illyahna Johnson
